Key points
• To describe the most frequent forms of arthritis and the physiopathology.
• To understand the subjacent proinﬂammatory status, fundamental to know the objectives of dietary strategies.
• To review the most important dietary modiﬁcations useful to slow or control the disease activity according to recent
evidence.
Introduction
The group of arthritis includes diverse forms of joint disease with or without some degree of inﬂammation. In this article these enti-
ties will be reviewed from a physiopathological and clinical perspective. Among the reviewed pathologies RA and OA are the most
